meta.source: World Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal
meta.coverage: India, rain and drought: CMIP6 historical runs (the models' own past), annual.
meta.note: CMIP6 multi-model ensemble (about 30 models), downscaled and bias-corrected to 0.25° by CCKP. Projections are model output under a stated scenario, not observations; the 10th to 90th percentile is the spread across models. Historical runs are the models' reproduction of the past, for comparing like with like; they are not observations.
